text:
[Council File 26-1332]
Motion (Padilla - Blumenfield) relative to the City’s compliance with Assembly Bill 1572 prohibiting the use of potable water to irrigate non-functional turf on most local government properties.
(This item was referred to the Public Works Committee and Energy and Environment Committee)
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For:
Sylmar Neighborhood Council
summary: Council asks whether the City complies with state law AB 1572, which bars using drinking water to irrigate non-functional turf on most government properties.

details.action: compliance review of state limits on potable water irrigation of non-functional turf
